# crosswork_collection_jobs_cadence (Data Source)

This data source can read the cadence of the Crosswork collection jobs that Device Lifecycle Management runs itself, the settings of the Collection Jobs Cadence (DLM) panel of the Collection Jobs page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_collection_jobs_cadence" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `reachability_check` (Number) Seconds between two reachability checks of the devices
- `show_clock` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the clock of the devices (`show clock`)
- `snmp_check` (Number) Seconds between two SNMP checks of the devices
- `te_tunnel_id` (Number) Seconds between two collections of the TE tunnel ids
